meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能为 InfiniteTalk 生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的分幕提示词：五幕、每幕 5s、9:16 竖屏，含帧级动作、音频同步和角色一致性描述，另附参数配置表，并可做质量核查与归档。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、用 InfiniteTalk 模型推理时触发；常见场景类型有产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等。

say.text: 帮我生成小省导购员带货视频第一幕的提示词，场景是产品推荐
say.note: 输出该幕提示词和参数配置表

say.text: 帮我核查这五幕提示词的角色一致性和音频匹配

say.text: 帮我把这一幕的 Suno 音乐和语音对齐到 5 秒并做唇形同步

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates shot-by-shot prompts for InfiniteTalk shopping-avatar videos: five 5s shots in 9:16, with frame-level actions, audio sync and character-consistency notes, plus a parameter table and a quality check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to make a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital-human video with the InfiniteTalk model, e.g. product recommendation, price comparison or promotion scenes.

say_en.text: Generate shot 1 prompts for a product-recommendation shopping video.
say_en.note: Returns that shot's prompt and parameter table.

say_en.text: Check these five shots for character consistency and audio match.
say_en.note: Gives a pass/fail report and issue list.

say_en.text: Align this shot's Suno music and voice to 5s with lip sync.
say_en.note: Outputs audio encoding files and steps.
